en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of the ornate pulpit and part of the interior wall with an arched doorway of an old church. The wall is aged with visible cracks and faded murals. The pulpit features baroque-style decor with carved religious figures. The postcard also includes text at the bottom right identifying the location as 'Lidens gamla kyrka. Interiör', which translates to 'Liden's old church. Interior.' The reverse side includes printed Swedish text indicating the publisher and a typical postcard layout.
